name: @4626/zora-csw-indexer
description: Indexes Zora-created Coinbase Smart Wallets on Base into Supabase by subscribing to the ZoraAccountManager's ZoraSmartWalletCreated event, then enriches each row with current on-chain owners via ownerAtIndex. The primary asset this service produces is a queryable (csw_address -> owner_eoas[]) table used for pre-qualified outreach and install-flow routing.
